name: Uber COTA v1→v2
case_period: 2018 paper; production period not precisely dated
task: 工单类型和回复模板推荐，由客服人员选择。
input: 工单原文、工单元数据、用户信息、行程信息。
representation_and_boundaries: 工单类别来自业务树，回复模板是另一个目标；原文仍直接进入模型，不要求先提完通用投诉字段。用户/行程元数据是业务系统提供，不是从原文猜测补全。
workflow: 新工单汇集四类特征并预计算预测
v1清洗/分词/TF-IDF和LSA表示→工单与类别/模板相似度→随机森林逐点排序
v2分类型编码输入→合并表示→类别路径解码及依赖类别的回复解码
客服打开时检查工单是否更新；更新则重算
展示Top3类型和模板，客服选择并完成处理
human_role: 客服是最后选择者；训练来自历史处理记录。

outcomes.population: English-language tickets; thousands of agents randomly assigned; tickets solved solely by one arm retained
outcomes.limitations: Exact arm sizes, test duration, absolute times, confidence interval and v1/v2-specific effect not provided. Customer satisfaction described as same or slightly higher, without a single precise aggregate effect.

outcomes.population: offline historical dataset comparison; paper reports random train/validation/test split with about94K test tickets; Table5 does not restate split in its caption

failure_and_iteration: 长尾类别表现差，过时/低频类型和模板增加数据稀疏；论文提出清理不用的类别和补充元数据。
字符C-RNN离线略好，但WordCNN评估全验证集2分钟而前者17.5分钟；选择更快模型。
两个目标各自预测不足以保证一致性；类别→回复依赖改善联合正确率。

transferable_lessons.lesson: 先做可供工作人员选用的历史候选，再评价找案时间与相关性。
transferable_lessons.condition: COTA候选是类别/模板，本项目候选是历史案件；相关性评价仍需本项目定义。

transferable_lessons.lesson: 保留原文检索基线，让结构信息作为可评估的增量信号。
transferable_lessons.condition: 历史案件可靠元数据可用时直接使用；本轮不要求新增外部数据。

transferable_lessons.lesson: 标签层级和输出之间的依赖是业务设计问题。
transferable_lessons.condition: 当前80条可用于观察边界和长尾，不能复制约300万条训练规模。

sources.title: COTA: Improving the Speed and Accuracy of Customer Support through Ranking and Deep Networks

evidence_locations.claim: Four input families; agents see Top-3 suggestions and choose.
evidence_locations.quote: The top three ranked predictions are suggested to agents

evidence_locations.claim: TF-IDF/LSA candidate-class similarities and Random Forest pointwise ranking; template text also used.
evidence_locations.quote: Historical tickets associated with each contact type and reply template are collected

evidence_locations.claim: ECD combines heterogeneous inputs; contact-type hierarchy and decoder dependency encode task knowledge.
About 3M tickets, random train 2.8M/validation94K/test94K split; classes have long tail.
evidence_locations.quote: About 3M tickets were collected and split randomly

evidence_locations.claim: Offline metrics and architecture comparisons, including Word CNN speed/accuracy choice.
Rare categories do worse; authors propose relevant metadata and consolidation of unused classes.
evidence_locations.quote: the model performs much better on frequent classes than rare ones

evidence_locations.claim: Production agent-randomized A/B on English tickets, thousands of agents; handling time ~10% reduction; p~1e-8; no exact arm counts/duration or raw means.
evidence_locations.qualifier: Mathematical formatting normalized; paper does not isolate this online effect by v1 versus v2.

name: Alibaba AliMe Assist→AliMe KBQA
case_period: 2017 Assist; 2018 Double11 KBQA deployment reported in2019 paper
task: 中文为主电商问答、任务服务及商家促销规则查询；同一产品家族的两次系统设计。
input: 用户问题文本、上一轮问题、已有知识项/实体/属性/规则；语音可经输入层进入。
representation_and_boundaries: 不同服务任务使用不同schema。Assist区分任务槽位、意图、知识实体与闲聊；KBQA区分实体、属性、约束及答案列，并维护知识的层级和适用条件。
workflow: Assist规则匹配/意图识别区分任务服务、业务问答和闲聊
任务型先定义必填/选填槽位，再字典/模式提取，缺必填时澄清
知识问答将用户不同说法归一到知识实体，查询KG；缺答时一次拼接上一轮，仍缺则检索补充，失败后转人工
KBQA由人工构造属性层级、键值文本和CVT条件表
Trie识别实体、实体遮盖后CNN预测属性；规则/相似度识别并绑定约束
LambdaRank排序候选查询图，Top1回答或Top3推荐，需要时按已建模规则推理
human_role: 业务分析师复核实体、定义关系与schema、配置知识，用户补齐必需槽位；客服承接未匹配问题。

outcomes.limitations: Paper calls this precision but does not specify macro/micro averaging; not slot-extraction accuracy.

outcomes.denominator: sessions: rr=1-U/T; U includes disliked/no-answer/explicit staff-request sessions
outcomes.comparison: Authors say 10-percent higher than QA-style representation and question-question matching; precise relative-vs-absolute interpretation not supplied
outcomes.limitations: Operational authors report; no randomized test, raw means, arm sizes or independent factual audit given.

outcomes.metric: resolution-rate absolute gain in further scenarios
outcomes.location: P20 PDF p.8 Table2 and preceding paragraph

outcomes.interpretation: Fewer matching/training targets; not same-unit storage reduction and not a measured latency gain.

outcomes.population: Double12 following Double11 deployment of same schema family
outcomes.limitations: Author-reported incremental reuse case, not complete initial system build time.

failure_and_iteration: Assist知识图谱仅覆盖常问子集，所以保留检索提高召回。
单纯QA对枚举在商家复杂场景中冗余；相同词项间的修饰关系与条件决定答案。
KBQA人工schema成本仍未解决；当时场景无需实体消歧，并不能据此省去政务地址消歧。
Assist闲聊A/B的Top1可接受率不支持业务问答或投诉抽取的准确率。
KBQA解决率是基于会话行为的操作指标，安静退出可能不等于事实正确。

transferable_lessons.lesson: 先把原文片段、规范概念、事项角色和查询条件分清，各自对应不同方法与判错方式。
transferable_lessons.condition: 规则、同义词映射、分类/LLM可分工，具体本地模型未定。

transferable_lessons.lesson: 历史表述可以帮助积累同义表达和边界反例，归一结果应保留原文证据。
transferable_lessons.condition: 历史答复相似只提供候选，同义关系仍需复核；投诉中的同一办理结果不保证同一问题。

transferable_lessons.lesson: 结构路线服务于高约束场景，原文检索补充长尾覆盖。
transferable_lessons.condition: 是否需要知识图谱由错误分布和成本决定，不因AliMe成功就新增图谱。

transferable_lessons.lesson: 字段应附带对下游的作用：影响召回、排序、同案关联、规则限制还是仅展示。
transferable_lessons.condition: 没有原文依据的地点/属性不自动补齐；不照搬电商任务的默认槽位。
